title: How Lervit Uses AI to Calculate Moving Costs in Calgary
metaTitle: How Lervit Uses AI for Moving Quotes in Calgary
metaDescription: Learn how Lervit's Vision Engine™ analyzes photos to generate accurate moving quotes in Calgary — no in-home estimates, no phone calls needed.
excerpt: Lervit's Vision Engine™ analyzes photos of your belongings and generates an accurate moving quote in minutes. Here's exactly how it works.

paragraphs: Lervit's Vision Engine™ is the AI system behind every moving quote on our platform. When you photograph your belongings, the system identifies each item — sofas, mattresses, appliances, boxes, and more — and estimates the volume and weight of your move automatically.

The Vision Engine™ is trained on thousands of common household items across Calgary moves. This means it recognizes not just obvious pieces like a dining table, but also awkward items like floor lamps, treadmills, and irregularly shaped furniture.

Once the AI builds an inventory of your items, it calculates the total move volume in cubic feet. This volume is the primary driver of your quote — more items mean more truck space and more labor time. The system then factors in your move distance and any access conditions you've noted, such as elevator-only buildings or stairwells.

The entire process — from photo upload to quote delivery — typically takes under 2 minutes. Traditional in-home estimates require scheduling a sales visit, waiting days for availability, and receiving a quote that may still change on moving day.

sections.h2: Why AI Quotes Beat Traditional Estimates
paragraphs: Traditional moving quotes are based on a salesperson's visual judgment during a short in-home visit. These estimates are inherently subjective and often miss items in storage, closets, or garages. The result: surprise charges on moving day.

AI-based quotes are data-driven. The Vision Engine™ has processed thousands of Calgary moves and knows, for example, how much volume a typical 2-bedroom apartment generates, what factors add time to a stair carry, and how item density affects truck space.

Because the quote is generated from photos you provide, you stay in control of what's included. If you forget to photograph items in the garage or storage locker, you'll be reminded — which reduces the chance of last-minute additions at move time.
Every Lervit quote locks in your price at the time of booking. What you see is what you pay, with no fuel surcharges or hidden labor costs added at the end.

sections.h2: Tips for Getting the Most Accurate Quote
paragraphs: For the most accurate AI quote, photograph every room — including closets, storage areas, and garages. Items not in the photos won't be counted, and adding them on moving day can change your price.
Use good lighting. Natural daylight or bright overhead lighting produces the clearest images. Blurry or dark photos reduce the Vision Engine's™ ability to accurately identify and size your items.
Take corner-angle overview shots of each room, then add close-up photos of large or unusual items. This combination gives the AI both scale context and item detail.

If you have particularly valuable or fragile items — antiques, artwork, a piano — mention these in the notes field at booking. These items may require special handling and equipment that the AI will factor into your quote.

faq.q: Do I need to photograph every single item?
faq.a: Start with corner-angle room overviews, then add close-ups of large, heavy, or unusual items. You don't need a photo of every individual book, but make sure shelves and storage areas are visible in your room shots.

faq.q: How accurate is the AI quote compared to the final price?
faq.a: When customers photograph all their items, Lervit quotes match the final price in the vast majority of cases. The most common reason for price differences is items added on moving day that weren't in the original photos.

faq.q: Can the AI handle unusual items like pianos or antiques?
faq.a: Yes. You can flag these items specifically when booking. For very high-value or fragile items, our team reviews the quote to ensure the right equipment and handling are arranged.

faq.q: Is the quoted price binding?
faq.a: Yes. Once you confirm your booking, the price is locked. The only reason the price would change is if you add items that weren't in the original photos or if access conditions differ significantly from what was described.

topCta.text: Get an instant moving quote — no calls, no wait

bottomCta.text: Ready to see how it works for your move?
bottomCta.sub: Upload photos and get your instant Calgary moving quote in under 2 minutes.

title: How to Take Photos for Accurate Moving Quotes in Calgary
metaTitle: How to Take Photos for Moving Quotes in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: Good photos lead to accurate moving quotes. Learn the exact photo techniques that get you the most precise price from Lervit's Vision Engine™ in Calgary.
excerpt: The accuracy of your Calgary moving quote depends largely on your photos. These tips will help you capture everything the AI needs for a precise price.

sections.h2: Why Photo Quality Matters for Your Quote
paragraphs: Lervit's Vision Engine™ generates your moving quote by analyzing photos of your belongings. The more clearly it can identify and size your items, the more accurate your quote will be. Poor or incomplete photos are the most common reason a final price differs from the original estimate.

The good news: you don't need professional photography skills. A few simple techniques — proper lighting, good angles, and thorough coverage — are all it takes to get an accurate moving quote for your Calgary move.

Start with room overviews. Stand in a corner of each room and take a wide shot that captures as much of the space as possible. This gives the AI both a count of items and a sense of their relative sizes. Do this for every room including bedrooms, living areas, and the kitchen.

Follow up with close-ups of large or unusual items. A sectional sofa, a king-size mattress, a treadmill, a large wardrobe — these items benefit from dedicated close-up shots so the system can accurately gauge their dimensions.

Don't forget storage spaces. Closets, garages, storage lockers, and attic spaces are frequently missed. A photo of a packed closet or a garage full of boxes can significantly affect your quote. If those items aren't in your photos, they won't be in your price.
For outdoor items — patio furniture, a BBQ, potted plants, garden equipment — take photos from outside or in your backyard. These items are often overlooked until moving day.

Use natural daylight when possible. Open blinds and curtains before taking photos. Bright, even lighting helps the AI distinguish items from shadows and walls, leading to more accurate identification.

Avoid shooting directly into bright windows or light sources. This creates silhouettes that are difficult for the system to analyze. If a room has strong backlighting, face away from the window when shooting.
For best results, take photos from eye level at a corner angle. This perspective shows the depth and width of the room simultaneously, giving the AI the most information in a single shot.
Steady, sharp photos are important. Blurry images reduce identification accuracy. Use both hands to hold your phone, or lean against a wall to stabilize yourself before taking the shot.

faq.q: How many photos should I take?
faq.a: At minimum, one corner-angle overview per room plus close-ups of any large, heavy, or unusual items. For a 2-bedroom apartment, most customers take 10–20 photos total.

faq.q: What if I have items I don't want to move?
faq.a: Take photos of everything in a room — you'll have a chance to mark specific items as "not moving" during the quote review step.

faq.q: Can I add more photos after I submit my quote?
faq.a: Yes. If you realize you've missed items, you can add photos before confirming your booking. After booking, contact support to update your move list.

faq.q: What happens if items not in my photos need to be moved?
faq.a: Any items added on moving day that weren't in your original quote will be priced separately. Your mover will explain and get your approval before proceeding.

topCta.text: Get an accurate quote from your photos

bottomCta.text: Take photos and get your instant moving quote
bottomCta.sub: Accurate Calgary moving quotes in under 2 minutes — no estimates, no surprises.

title: How to Read a Moving Quote in Calgary: What's Included
metaTitle: Understanding Moving Quotes in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: Learn what's included in a Lervit moving quote in Calgary — base price, labor, distance, access fees — and what you'll never be charged for.
excerpt: Moving quotes in Calgary can be confusing. Here's exactly what Lervit includes in every quote — and what you'll never be surprised by on moving day.

sections.h2: What's Included in Every Lervit Quote
paragraphs: A Lervit moving quote in Calgary is an all-inclusive price. There are no add-ons waiting at the end. Every quote includes: loading your items at the pickup location, transport to your destination, and unloading and placement at your new space.

Labor costs are built into the quote from the start. The system estimates how long your move will take based on item volume, number of floors, elevator access, and walking distance from the truck. That labor estimate — including a two-person or three-person crew where needed — is reflected in your final price before you book.

The base price accounts for the truck size required for your move. Lervit matches you with a right-sized vehicle — a cargo van for a single-item pickup, a 16-foot truck for a 2-bedroom apartment move. You're never paying for truck capacity you don't use.

sections.h2: What You'll Never Be Charged For
paragraphs: Fuel surcharges are not added to Lervit quotes. The distance and drive time between your pickup and destination are factored into the base price upfront.
There are no stair fees or elevator fees added at the end. If your building has stairs or a slow elevator, you mentioned it when getting your quote — and that access condition is already priced in.
Blankets, straps, and basic packing materials used to protect your furniture during transport are included. You won't be billed for protective materials your mover uses as part of standard care.
The price you confirm at booking is the price you pay. Lervit does not use hourly rates with open-ended "we'll see how long it takes" pricing. Your total is fixed when you book.

The only situation in which your final price may differ from your quote is if items are added on moving day that weren't included in your original photos. This is rare when customers photograph everything thoroughly.

If unexpected access conditions arise — for example, an elevator that's smaller than described, or a longer carry distance than estimated — your mover will discuss any adjustments with you before proceeding. You always have the right to approve or decline changes.
Lervit's quotes are accurate because they're based on AI analysis of your actual items and your actual move conditions — not a ballpark from someone guessing over the phone.

faq.q: Does the quote include disassembly and reassembly of furniture?
faq.a: Basic disassembly needed to move items safely through doorways is included. Full furniture assembly as a service is an add-on you can request at booking.

faq.q: Is GST included in the quoted price?
faq.a: Taxes applicable to your move will be shown at checkout before you confirm your booking, so there are no surprises.

faq.q: What if my move takes longer than estimated?
faq.a: Because Lervit uses fixed-price quotes rather than hourly rates, your price doesn't change if the move takes longer than the system estimated. You pay what was quoted.

faq.q: Can I get a quote for a partial move — just some rooms?
faq.a: Yes. When uploading photos, simply photograph the items you want moved. The Vision Engine™ generates a quote based on what's in the photos, not your entire home.

title: How to Book a Small Move in Calgary with Lervit
metaTitle: How to Book a Small Move in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: Booking a small move in Calgary — a couch, a few boxes, or a studio apartment — takes under 3 minutes with Lervit. No minimums, no truck rental needed.
excerpt: Small moves in Calgary don't have to be complicated. Lervit makes it easy to book single-item pickups, furniture delivery, and studio apartment moves in minutes.

sections.h2: What Counts as a Small Move?
paragraphs: A small move is any job that doesn't require a full moving truck. This includes single-item pickups like a sofa or mattress, furniture delivery from a store or Facebook Marketplace seller, studio or one-bedroom apartment moves, and small collections of boxes between locations.

Most moving companies have minimums of 2–3 hours, which means you're paying for time you don't need when you're only moving a few items. Lervit uses item-based pricing with no minimum charge — you pay for what you're actually moving.

This makes Lervit particularly well suited for Calgary's large population of apartment renters, students at UCalgary and SAIT, and anyone who bought something on Facebook Marketplace and needs help getting it home.
Visit app.lervit.com on your phone or computer. Start a new quote by photographing the items you need moved. For a single-item move, one or two photos is usually enough.
Enter your pickup address and destination. For furniture delivery from a seller, the pickup address is the seller's location. For a store like IKEA, just enter the store address.

Select a date and time. Lervit offers same-day availability for most small moves in Calgary — if you book before noon, there's a good chance a mover can be at your door the same day. For less urgent moves, book a few days ahead to get your preferred time slot.
Confirm your booking. A cargo van or right-sized truck will be dispatched for your small move. You won't be charged for a full moving truck if you're only moving a few items.

Your mover will arrive within the scheduled window. For small moves, a single professional mover with the right vehicle is typically dispatched. For heavier items like a sectional or appliances, a two-person team will be sent.
Track your mover in real-time through the app. You'll get a notification when they're on their way, along with an estimated arrival time that updates with live traffic.

Once your items are delivered and placed, you'll confirm completion in the app and payment is processed automatically. The whole process — from pickup to delivery — is typically complete within 1–2 hours for small moves across Calgary.

faq.q: Can Lervit pick up from a Facebook Marketplace seller?
faq.a: Yes. This is one of our most common small move types in Calgary. Just enter the seller's address as the pickup location and photograph the item for your quote.

faq.q: Do small moves cost more per item than large moves?
faq.a: No. Lervit uses the same pricing model regardless of move size. Smaller moves are simply less expensive in total because fewer items are being moved.

faq.q: Can I book a small move on the same day?
faq.a: Yes, same-day availability is common for small moves in Calgary. Book as early in the day as possible for the best chance of same-day service.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of items required?
faq.a: No minimum. Lervit will move a single item — one box, one lamp, one piece of furniture — with no minimum charge.

title: What to Expect on Moving Day in Calgary
metaTitle: What to Expect on Moving Day in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: A complete guide to moving day in Calgary with Lervit — from mover arrival to final walkthrough. Know exactly what happens, step by step.
excerpt: Moving day doesn't have to be stressful. Here's a complete walkthrough of what happens on the day of your Lervit move in Calgary, from arrival to completion.

paragraphs: On the morning of your move, you'll receive a notification confirming your mover is on their way, along with a real-time map view showing their location and estimated arrival time. This typically comes 30–60 minutes before arrival.

Use this window to do a final sweep of your space. Check every room, closet, and storage area to make sure nothing's been missed. Put aside items you'll carry yourself — valuables, documents, medications, and anything you'll need immediate access to.

If you live in a Calgary condo or apartment building, contact your building management to confirm the elevator reservation and loading zone access. Most buildings require this to be arranged in advance, and your mover will need clear access to both.

Reserve parking near your entrance. The closer the truck can park to your door, the faster — and cheaper — your move will be. If parking is limited, contact your building manager or the City of Calgary for a temporary loading zone permit.

Your mover will arrive within the scheduled window. If they're running late due to traffic, you'll receive a notification through the app. Lervit's real-time tracking means you'll always know where your mover is.

The mover will do a brief walkthrough with you to confirm all items to be moved and discuss any specific handling instructions. This is the time to point out fragile items, pieces that require disassembly, and anything that needs extra care.

Loading typically takes 1–3 hours for a 1–2 bedroom apartment move. Professional movers use proper lifting techniques, blankets, padding, and straps to protect both your belongings and your walls and floors.

During loading, stay accessible by phone or nearby. Movers may need quick decisions from you — where to set something aside, how to handle a difficult doorway, or whether a particular item is coming or staying.
During transport, track your mover's live location in the app. You'll see real-time updates so you know exactly when to be at your new address.

Unloading follows the same careful process as loading. Direct your movers on where furniture should go in your new space — they'll do their best to place items where you want them, saving you from heavy repositioning later.

Once everything is delivered, do a final walkthrough together. Check for any damage and confirm that all items arrived. Sign off on the completed move in the app and payment is processed automatically.
After your move, you'll be prompted to rate your mover and leave feedback. This helps other Calgary customers find great movers and keeps Lervit's quality standards high.

faq.q: What time of day should I schedule my move?
faq.a: Morning slots (8am–10am start) are popular for Calgary moves because they leave the full day for unloading and unpacking. Avoid Friday afternoon moves in Calgary — traffic can significantly extend drive times.

faq.q: What if my mover is late?
faq.a: You'll receive real-time tracking updates. If a mover is running late beyond the scheduled window, contact Lervit support through the app and we'll update you immediately.

faq.q: Can I direct where furniture is placed at my new home?
faq.a: Yes. Your movers will follow your instructions on furniture placement. Have a rough floor plan in mind before they arrive to keep things moving efficiently.

faq.q: What happens if something is damaged during the move?
faq.a: Report any damage through the app within 24 hours with photos. Lervit's support team will review your case and work to resolve it fairly.

bottomCta.text: Ready to move in Calgary?

title: How to Prepare Your Home for Movers in Calgary
metaTitle: How to Prepare Your Home for Movers in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: Preparing your Calgary home before movers arrive speeds up the job and reduces costs. Follow this guide to make your moving day run smoothly.
excerpt: A little preparation before your movers arrive can save time and money. Here's how to get your Calgary home ready for a smooth, efficient moving day.

paragraphs: Pack and seal all boxes the night before your movers arrive. Label each box clearly with its destination room — "Master Bedroom," "Kitchen," "Office." This lets your movers work efficiently without stopping to ask you where everything goes.

Disconnect and prepare appliances. Empty and defrost the refrigerator at least 12 hours before moving. Secure the washing machine drum with transit bolts (or let your mover know if you need help sourcing them). Coil all cables and appliance cords neatly and tape them to the appliance.
Take photos or video of all furniture arrangements in your new home if you have a specific layout in mind. This makes directing the movers faster and saves time on moving day.

Set aside a "do not move" pile for items you'll transport yourself — important documents, medications, laptop, wallet, keys, children's overnight bags. Place these in a clearly marked area or car so they don't accidentally get loaded.

Clear all pathways — hallways, doorways, and stairwells — of any obstacles. Remove rugs that could slip under heavy loads. Take down any wall art or decorations near doorways that could get bumped during the move.

Reserve parking close to your entrance. For Calgary homes with a driveway, this is simple. For apartment buildings, check with your building management about loading zone access or whether you need a temporary parking permit from the City.
Secure pets in a bedroom or crate. Moving days are hectic, and open doors present escape risks for dogs and cats. It also keeps pets away from the physical activity and stress of the loading process.
Have a small bag of moving day essentials within reach: phone charger, water and snacks for you and your movers, important documents, and any tips you plan to give.

Do a quick walkthrough with your movers when they arrive. Point out fragile or high-value items, pieces that need to be disassembled, and anything going to a different location than the main destination.
Stay nearby and accessible during loading. Your movers may have quick questions about specific items. Being on-site and responsive keeps the job moving forward without delays.
At your destination, be ready to direct furniture placement. Walking your movers through the floor plan — even briefly — means you won't have to rearrange heavy pieces yourself after they leave.

faq.q: Do I need to pack everything before the movers arrive?
faq.a: Yes. Lervit movers are not a packing service unless packing is specifically booked as an add-on. Have all boxes sealed and labeled before the crew arrives.

faq.q: Should I disassemble furniture myself?
faq.a: You can, but it's not required. Basic disassembly for doorway navigation is part of the move. If you disassemble furniture yourself, keep all hardware in a labelled bag taped to the piece.

faq.q: What if I live in a condo with a strict move-out time window?
faq.a: Book your Lervit move to start well before the building's cutoff time. Include the time window details in your booking notes so your mover is aware. Calgary condos typically allow 8am–12pm or specific elevator reservation windows.

faq.q: How far in advance should I reserve the elevator in my Calgary condo?
faq.a: Most Calgary condo buildings recommend reserving the freight elevator 1–2 weeks before your move date. Contact your building management office to book.

bottomCta.text: Ready? Get your instant moving quote now

title: How to Reschedule or Cancel a Move in Calgary
metaTitle: How to Reschedule or Cancel a Move in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: Plans change. Learn how to reschedule or cancel your Calgary move with Lervit — including what's free, what's not, and how to avoid fees.
excerpt: Moving plans don't always go smoothly. Here's how to reschedule or cancel your Calgary move with Lervit, and when you can do so at no charge.

sections.h2: Rescheduling With More Than 24 Hours' Notice
paragraphs: The easiest way to reschedule is through the app. Open your booking, tap "Reschedule Move," and select a new date and time from the available slots. Changes made more than 24 hours before your scheduled move are completely free.

Your original quote remains valid for the rescheduled date in most cases. If there's a significant difference in pricing between dates (for example, moving from a weekday to a weekend), you'll be shown the updated price before confirming.
Most rescheduled bookings are confirmed within minutes. A verified Calgary mover will be matched to your new time slot, and you'll receive a confirmation notification.
Life happens. If you need to reschedule within 24 hours of your move, contact Lervit support directly through the app's chat feature or by email. We'll do everything possible to accommodate you.
Last-minute rescheduling may involve a small fee to compensate the mover for the time they've reserved. This is handled on a case-by-case basis — we try to be fair to both customers and movers.
If the rescheduling is due to circumstances beyond your control — a lease delay, a building access problem, or an emergency — let our support team know. We're human about these situations.
Cancellations more than 24 hours before your move receive a full refund, processed within 3–5 business days. To cancel, go to your booking in the app and tap "Cancel Move."
Cancellations within 24 hours may be subject to a partial charge to compensate the mover for their reserved time. The exact amount depends on how close to the move time the cancellation occurs.

If your move needs to be cancelled due to a medical emergency or extraordinary circumstance, contact support directly. We handle these situations individually and look for the fairest resolution for everyone involved.

faq.q: Can I change my move destination after booking?
faq.a: Yes, destination changes can be made up to 24 hours before your move. If the new destination significantly changes the drive distance, your quote will be updated accordingly.

faq.q: What if the building management delays my move-in date?
faq.a: This is a common situation in Calgary's rental market. Contact support as early as possible with documentation of the delay, and we'll work with you on a penalty-free reschedule.

faq.q: How do I contact support for urgent rescheduling?
faq.a: Use the in-app chat feature for the fastest response. Support is available 7 days a week during business hours.

title: The Complete Moving Day Checklist for Calgary Moves
metaTitle: Moving Day Checklist for Calgary Moves | Lervit
metaDescription: Don't forget anything on moving day. This complete Calgary moving day checklist covers everything from the morning before movers arrive to after you're settled in.
excerpt: Moving in Calgary? Use this complete moving day checklist to make sure nothing gets forgotten — from morning prep to final walkthrough at your new home.

paragraphs: Confirm your booking and check your mover's ETA in the Lervit app. You'll see a real-time map showing when they'll arrive.

Do a final walk-through of every room, including closets, the bathroom cabinet, the garage, and outdoor spaces. Check under beds and in the backs of wardrobes — these are the places things most often get left behind.
Take photos or video of your current space for reference. These serve as documentation of your home's condition before the move and as a visual record for insurance purposes.

Put your "do not move" items — medications, laptop, chargers, documents, kids' bags, valuables — in a single designated spot, ideally in your car. Make sure these are clearly separate from items the movers will be loading.
Confirm parking is available near your building's entrance. If you're in a Calgary condo, verify the freight elevator reservation is confirmed with your building management.
Walk through the space with your movers. Point out fragile items, pieces that need disassembly, and anything going to a different destination than the main address.
Provide any gate codes, elevator access cards, or building-specific instructions your movers will need. Have the destination address confirmed in writing — either in the app or as a note.
Secure pets in a room or crate away from the loading area. Keep children in a safe, supervised space during the move.
Stay nearby and accessible throughout loading. Even 15 minutes away can create delays if movers have questions that require your input.
Arrive at your destination before the movers. Check that the space is accessible, the elevator is available (if applicable), and there's parking for the truck.
Have a plan for furniture placement. Even a rough sketch or mental floor plan helps you direct the movers quickly and saves heavy repositioning later.
Do a final check together before the movers leave. Walk through all rooms, verify nothing was missed or damaged, and sign off on the move in the app.

After the move, unpack essentials first — kitchen, bedding, bathroom. Report any damage within 24 hours through the app with photos. Rate your mover to help other Calgary customers find great local movers.

faq.q: What should I set aside to take myself on moving day?
faq.a: Important documents (ID, lease, insurance), medications, laptop and chargers, one change of clothes, snacks, and anything you'll need that first night before you unpack.

faq.q: Should I be home the entire time?
faq.a: Yes, for loading and unloading. During transport, you can travel separately to your destination — just be there when the movers arrive to direct placement.

faq.q: Is it a good idea to clean the old place before movers arrive?
faq.a: Do your final cleaning after the movers leave — you'll inevitably leave floor dust and scuffs that only become visible once the furniture is gone. Focus on preparation before the move, cleaning after.

title: How Moving Costs Are Calculated in Calgary
metaTitle: How Moving Costs Are Calculated in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: Learn exactly how Calgary moving costs are determined — item volume, distance, access conditions, and labor time — and how Lervit keeps pricing transparent.
excerpt: Calgary moving prices vary widely — and not always fairly. Here's a transparent breakdown of exactly how moving costs are calculated with Lervit.

sections.h2: The Four Factors That Drive Moving Costs
paragraphs: Move volume is the primary cost driver. The more items you're moving, the larger the truck needed and the longer the job will take. Lervit calculates volume in cubic feet from photos of your belongings using AI analysis.

Distance is the second factor. A local small move within one Calgary neighbourhood costs less than a cross-city move from Tuscany to Cranston. Drive time and fuel are factored into your quote based on the actual route between your addresses.

Access conditions affect labor time significantly. A ground-floor condo with a loading dock is faster to move than a 12th-floor unit with a slow elevator and a long corridor. Stairs, tight hallways, and long carries from truck to door all add to the time required.

Crew size is determined by the volume and weight of your move. A single-item furniture pickup might only need one mover. A 3-bedroom house move needs a full crew of 3. Lervit automatically determines the right crew size for your job.

sections.h2: How This Compares to Hourly Rate Companies
paragraphs: Most traditional Calgary moving companies charge by the hour. The quote you get over the phone is an estimate — the final bill depends on how long it actually takes. This creates risk for you: a job that runs over estimate means an unexpectedly high bill.

Lervit uses fixed-price quotes. After analyzing your photos and move details, the system sets a final price before you book. That price doesn't change on moving day regardless of how long the job takes.

This model is particularly advantageous for small moves in Calgary. Most hourly-rate companies have a 2–3 hour minimum, which means you pay $250–$400 even if you're only moving a couch and a few boxes. Lervit's item-based pricing means a small move costs what a small move should cost.

Every Lervit quote includes loading, transport, and unloading. There are no fuel surcharges, no stair fees, no hidden add-ons for using blankets or straps. The access conditions you noted when getting your quote are already built into the price.

For small moves in Calgary, prices typically start around $49 for a single-item pickup and scale based on volume and distance. A typical 1-bedroom apartment move in Calgary runs $299–$499. A 2-bedroom move runs $400–$699.

The final price you see before booking is what you pay. Lervit is designed around price transparency because hidden fees are one of the biggest pain points customers report about the traditional Calgary moving industry.

faq.q: Why do weekend moves cost more with some companies?
faq.a: Weekend surcharges are common with traditional movers. Lervit does not apply weekend surcharges — pricing is based on your move details, not the day of the week.

faq.q: Do prices go up for last-minute or same-day moves?
faq.a: No. Lervit does not apply rush fees or same-day surcharges. The price is based on your move details, regardless of when you book.

faq.q: Is there a minimum charge for small moves?
faq.a: No. Lervit has no minimum charge. A single-item move costs what a single-item move should cost — often under $100 for local Calgary delivery.

faq.q: How do I get a lower quote?
faq.a: Accurate photos of your exact items give you the most precise price. Overphotographing is better than underphotographing. You can also save by being flexible with timing and booking a few days in advance.

Being accurate about access conditions when getting your quote prevents these situations. If you're uncertain, note the worst-case scenario rather than the ideal one.

paragraphs: If your move involved stair carries, a high floor without a working elevator, difficult access, very heavy items (appliances, a piano, a sectional), or a longer-than-expected job, your mover has worked especially hard. A tip in these situations is a strong signal of appreciation.

If your move was straightforward and the mover was simply efficient and professional, that's also worth recognizing. Great movers make the job look easy — which is the skill, not a reason to tip less.
If the mover arrived late, was dismissive of your instructions, or didn't handle your items carefully, a tip is entirely at your discretion. Use the rating system to document your experience.
Offer water or cold drinks, especially on hot Calgary summer moving days. Movers work physically hard for hours, and staying hydrated makes a real difference.
Leave a detailed, honest review in the Lervit app. A strong review has a direct impact on a mover's ability to get future bookings. It's free, takes 2 minutes, and goes a long way.
Have your move prepared — items packed, pathways cleared, parking arranged. A well-prepared move lets movers work efficiently, which movers genuinely appreciate.

title: How Lervit Verifies Movers in Calgary

metaDescription: Every Lervit mover in Calgary passes a background check, vehicle inspection, and identity verification before accepting jobs. Here's exactly how the vetting works.
excerpt: Letting strangers move your belongings requires trust. Here's the step-by-step process Lervit uses to verify every mover before they can accept jobs in Calgary.

paragraphs: Every mover who applies to Lervit's platform in Calgary goes through a multi-step verification process before they're approved to accept jobs. This process cannot be skipped or fast-tracked.

Identity verification is the first step. All applicants must provide government-issued photo ID, which is verified against their application details. Mismatched or fraudulent IDs are rejected immediately.

Criminal background checks are conducted through certified screening agencies. Movers with relevant criminal history are not approved. Background checks are renewed periodically — approval isn't permanent.
Valid driver's licenses are confirmed with the issuing province and must match the vehicle being used. Movers must maintain a clean driving record to remain active on the platform.

Verification doesn't end at onboarding. Lervit monitors mover performance continuously through customer ratings and reviews. Every completed move generates a rating from the customer.

Movers whose average rating drops below 4.0 stars receive a performance notice and additional review. Repeated issues — damage, tardiness, unprofessional conduct — result in suspension or removal from the platform.
Movers can be removed immediately in response to a serious complaint with documented evidence. Customer safety and satisfaction is the primary criterion — not mover tenure.
Lervit also monitors completion rates. Movers who frequently cancel jobs at short notice or show a pattern of unreliability are flagged and reviewed, regardless of their rating.

No verification process eliminates all risk. Despite thorough screening, exceptional situations can occur. This is why Lervit also maintains the rating system, in-app communication, and a support team available for every move.
If you ever have a concern about a mover's conduct — before, during, or after your move — report it through the app immediately. Customer reports are taken seriously and reviewed within 24 hours.

excerpt: If something gets damaged during your Calgary move, here's exactly what to do — how to document it, how to report it, and how Lervit resolves damage claims.

paragraphs: Lervit movers are trained in professional packing and handling techniques before they're approved to work on the platform. This includes proper wrapping for fragile items, securing furniture with straps and blankets, and protecting floors and door frames during loading.

The right crew size matters. A mover attempting to carry a sectional sofa alone is a recipe for damage — to the furniture and the walls. Lervit's system dispatches a crew based on the volume and weight of your move, ensuring jobs aren't understaffed.

Communication before and during the move reduces damage risk. When you walk through your items with the mover at the start of the job and point out fragile or valuable pieces, movers can prepare the right materials and approach for each item.

If you notice damage during or after your move, the most important first step is documentation. Take clear photos of the damaged item as soon as you notice it. Try to capture both the damage itself and the item's context (where it is in the room, which part is damaged).
Report the damage to Lervit support within 24 hours of your move completing. This time window is important — reports filed significantly later are more difficult to investigate accurately.

To file a damage report, go to your completed booking in the Lervit app and tap "Report an Issue." Attach your photos and describe the damage in detail. A support team member will contact you within 24 hours to begin the review.

Lervit reviews damage claims with input from both the customer and the mover. If the damage is confirmed and the mover is at fault, Lervit facilitates a resolution — which may include repair cost reimbursement, item replacement value, or a service credit depending on the situation.

For items valued over $1,000, we strongly recommend declaring them at booking and photographing them in detail before the move. This documentation is your strongest protection if a claim needs to be filed.

Irreplaceable or sentimental items — family heirlooms, original artwork, antiques — should be considered for personal transport if the emotional value significantly exceeds the replacement value. No verification or claims process can replace a truly irreplaceable item.
If you have a collection of high-value items that warrant special handling, mention this at booking. We can ensure the right crew and materials are assigned for your specific move.

faq.q: What if the damage was there before the move?
faq.a: This is why pre-move photos are important. Document the condition of valuable items before the movers arrive. Pre-existing damage is not eligible for a claim.

faq.q: How are claim amounts determined?
faq.a: Claims are assessed based on the current replacement or repair cost of the item, not the original purchase price. Claims are reviewed individually and resolved case-by-case.

faq.q: What if I disagree with the claim resolution?
faq.a: Contact Lervit support to escalate the case. You can provide additional evidence, and the case will be reviewed by a senior support member.

title: Moving Insurance in Calgary: What's Covered and What's Not
metaTitle: Moving Insurance in Calgary: What's Covered | Lervit
metaDescription: Understand moving insurance in Calgary — what Lervit covers, when to consider extra insurance, and how to protect high-value items on your move.
excerpt: Moving insurance in Calgary isn't always what it seems. Here's an honest breakdown of what's covered when you move with Lervit and when extra coverage makes sense.

paragraphs: Every Lervit move in Calgary comes with professional handling standards enforced by our mover verification and rating system. Movers are trained in wrapping, padding, and securing furniture to prevent damage during transport.

Furniture is moved with blankets, straps, and protective materials as standard practice. Fragile items are handled separately and loaded last. Door frames, corners, and floors are protected on moves where access conditions require it.

Lervit's damage claims process provides a resolution pathway when items are damaged due to mover error. Claims must be filed within 24 hours with photographic evidence. Verified claims are resolved through repair cost reimbursement or item replacement value.
This is not the same as formal insurance coverage — it's a platform accountability system. For high-value moves, understanding the difference matters.

Standard moving companies in Canada typically offer released value protection, which covers items at a flat rate per pound (usually $0.60/lb). This means a $2,000 laptop weighing 2kg would be covered for a few dollars under released value protection. It's legal protection, not real coverage.
Full value protection is a higher coverage tier that some moving companies offer as an add-on. It covers the actual replacement value of damaged items. Lervit is developing this as a premium option.

Your existing home insurance policy may cover your belongings during a move. Check with your broker before your move date — some policies extend coverage during transit, and others require a specific endorsement. If you're between homes on moving day, confirm that your coverage doesn't lapse during the transition.

For high-value art, jewelry, electronics, or collections, a specialized moving floater through your insurance provider is the most comprehensive protection available. This is separate from anything a moving company offers.

sections.h2: What to Do Before Moving High-Value Items
paragraphs: Photograph all high-value items in detail before the move. Include photos of serial numbers for electronics, close-ups of any existing wear or damage, and wide shots showing the item's overall condition.
Declare high-value items at booking. This allows Lervit to ensure the right crew and materials are assigned. Movers are more careful when they know what's at stake.
Consider personal transport for truly irreplaceable items. Jewelry, important documents, irreplaceable family photos, and small high-value electronics can travel with you rather than on the truck.

faq.q: Does Lervit provide insurance for my move?
faq.a: Lervit provides a damage claims resolution process rather than formal insurance. For full value protection on high-value items, check your existing home insurance policy or consult your broker about a moving floater.

faq.q: Am I covered if the moving truck is in an accident?
faq.a: Lervit movers carry valid vehicle insurance. In the case of a vehicle incident, the claims process would involve the mover's vehicle insurance and Lervit's support team.

faq.q: What's the most important thing I can do to protect my belongings?
faq.a: Photograph everything before the move, declare high-value items at booking, and file any damage reports within 24 hours with clear photos. Documentation is your most important protection tool.

title: How Mover Ratings Protect You When Moving in Calgary
metaTitle: How Mover Ratings Protect You in Calgary | Lervit
metaDescription: Lervit's rating system ensures only the best movers keep working in Calgary. Learn how ratings are collected, what they mean, and how they help you book with confidence.
excerpt: Mover ratings are one of Lervit's most important safety tools. Here's how the rating system works in Calgary and why your feedback makes a real difference.

paragraphs: After every completed move, customers are asked to rate their mover on a 1-to-5 star scale and leave optional written feedback. This rating is tied to the mover's profile and is factored into their overall score.

Ratings are visible to future customers before they book. When you're matched with a mover, you'll see their star rating, total number of completed moves, and sample reviews from past Calgary customers.
The rating is a rolling average. A mover with 200 completed moves and a 4.9 rating has consistently performed well across a large number of real jobs — that signal is meaningful.

Written reviews give you context that numbers can't. A review that mentions "handled our grand piano with extra care" or "navigated a very tight staircase without a scratch" tells you something specific about that mover's capabilities.

Movers with high ratings receive priority matching — they get first access to jobs in their area. This creates a direct incentive for movers to perform well, communicate professionally, and handle your belongings carefully.
Movers whose average rating drops below 4.0 stars receive a performance notice from Lervit. Continued low ratings result in reduced job access or suspension from the platform.

A single serious complaint with documented evidence can result in immediate account review regardless of overall rating. Rating history is a long-term indicator — it doesn't override individual serious incidents.

Your rating after a move isn't just feedback for the mover — it's information for the next Calgary customer who might book that same mover. Taking a minute to leave an honest, specific review is a meaningful contribution to the platform's quality.

If your mover was exceptional — showed up on time, worked quickly, handled your items carefully, communicated well — say so in the review. Great movers deserve the recognition, and it helps them build a sustainable business.

If your experience was below expectations, be specific and factual in your review. Vague low ratings are less useful than a review that says "arrived 40 minutes late without a notification" or "a chair was scratched during loading."

faq.q: Can a mover see who left them a review?
faq.a: Movers can see ratings and written reviews, but reviewer identities are kept private unless you choose to include your name in the review text.

faq.q: What if I forget to rate my mover?
faq.a: You'll receive a reminder notification after your move. You can also leave a rating anytime by going to the completed booking in the app.

faq.q: Can a mover dispute a review?
faq.a: Movers can flag reviews they believe are inaccurate or fraudulent. Disputed reviews are reviewed by the Lervit support team. Verified honest reviews are not removed.
